rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambush Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Anti-Regen
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Bane
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Bane when Shooting
rules.description: This model gets Bane on its weapons when shooting.

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Bounding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bounding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Changebound
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Changebound
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Changebound, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Changebound (instead of only when shooting/charging from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Changebound Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Changebound. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Screened
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Screened, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Screened (instead of only when shooting/charging from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Fear
rules.description: When in melee with this model, enemies count as having taken +X wounds when checking who won.

rules.name: Fearless
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

rules.name: Fearless Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fearless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Indirect
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

rules.name: Indirect when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Indirect on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Lacerate
rules.description: When attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Protected
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Protected Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Protected. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Screened
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

rules.name: Sergeant
rules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

rules.name: Spell Accumulator
rules.description: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Spell Resistance
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

rules.name: Spell Resistance Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Spell Resistance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Split
rules.description: When this unit is fully destroyed, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it before removing the last model. Units placed via Split can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Teleport Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Teleport. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

spells.name: Breath of Change
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Bane when Shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Change Boon
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Changebound once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Mutating Inferno
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 24" in line of sight, which take 3 hits each.

spells.name: Power Bolt
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with AP(2).

spells.name: Shifting Form
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which loses 2 spell tokens. Note that the target may not spend those spell tokens to prevent this effect.

spells.name: Sky Blaze
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with Lacerate.
